checks.detail: AC-6 is not_met (Happy path works. The Linear proxy changed TRU-11's Stage to Blocked at 15:34:21 with the native app running. The server read it at 15:34:33 and the app showed it at 15:35:02, 41 s later, with no reload (03-after-4.png; still unchanged at 03-after-3.png, 15:34:52). A second change, to PR review at 15:59:32, showed by 16:00:06 while GitHub was failing. 'Last refreshed N min ago' is shown, but it gives the age of the oldest source. Without a token that was GitHub, so it read 27-39 min while Linear changes landed within a minute. It fails a case the author's tests don't cover: a read the server never answers. With a listener on :8080 that accepts and never responds, the app's read stayed in flight from 16:05:00 past 16:08:00, Refresh stayed disabled, and no further reads were sent. ehttp 0.7.3's fetch() sets no timeout: fetch_raw_native(true) skips timeout_recv_body. The real server was then brought back at 16:09:11 with TRU-11 changed to Rollout. At 16:11:41 the app still showed PR review, the old 'Couldn't refresh ... Connection refused' text and a disabled Refresh (11-stuck-after-server-back.png). It updated only after the held connection was closed (12-released.png). One stalled read freezes the board until the app is restarted, so it doesn't keep itself current without the owner's action. The 'a PR's checks finish' part is claimed only with GITHUB_TOKEN. Without one, GitHub was read at 15:32:39 and next at 15:59:19 (about 27 min, spaced by cost), so a finished check would not show within 2 minutes tokenless. The with-token behaviour is covered only by the fake-backed test.)

checks.name: no_blocking_findings
checks.detail: 1 open: crates/app/src/main.rs fetch(): the snapshot request has no timeout. ehttp 0.7.3's fetch() calls fetch_raw_native(true), which sets no timeout. A read the server never answers stays in flight forever: due() never fires again and Refresh stays disabled. Observed: with a listener holding the connection from 16:05, and the real server back at 16:09:11 with a new stage, the app still showed the old stage at 16:11:41. AC-6 isn't met after one stalled read. Setting a timeout on the request, e.g. Request::with_timeout or a deadline on in_flight, would fix it.

crates/app/src/lib.rs board(): 'Last refreshed N min ago' is the oldest source's last_good. Without a token that is GitHub, so it read '27 min ago' to '39 min ago' while Linear changes were landing within a minute, and while the app itself had just read the snapshot. The wording suggests the board hasn't refreshed. Consider naming what the age is for, or showing the app's own last read.
crates/app/src/lib.rs board(): a stale source's line isn't wrapped. GitHub's error ran past the 2000 px window and was cut off mid-text ('kept its PRs from an ea...').
